name: Ziploc Baggie
desc: Stabilises a wild Astral. Works best when it is worn out.

name: Rizla Paper
desc: Wraps tighter than a baggie. Better odds.

name: Amber Vial
desc: Lab-grade containment. Rarely fails.

name: Coconut Water
desc: Warm, half finished. Restores 25 Serotonin.

name: Watermelon Slice
desc: Restores 60 Serotonin.

name: Masala Chai
desc: Restores all Serotonin.

name: Water Bottle
desc: Restores 40 Hydration. A sip for you too brings you down a band or so.

name: Electrolyte Sachet
desc: Restores all Hydration and cures Cottonmouth.

name: Tiger Balm
desc: Cures any status condition. Smells like a decision.

name: Weighted Blanket
desc: Brings a fainted Astral back with half its Serotonin.

name: Incense Stick
desc: Keeps wild Astrals away for 120 steps.

name: Wraparound Shades
desc: While you carry these, people notice you from one tile less.

name: Earplugs
desc: While you carry these, your Astrals shake off Thought Loops sooner.

name: Warm Kingfisher
desc: A catalyst. Some Astrals change when they drink it.

name: Mystery Powder
desc: A catalyst. Nobody will say what is in it.

name: Banana Lassi
desc: A catalyst. Thick, sweet, transformative.

name: Glowing Blotter
desc: Lick a corner to go up a band: stranger Astrals and bigger lessons, harder hits and clumsier hands. It never runs out, which is the problem.

name: Passport
desc: Yours. Slightly chewed.

name: Undercover Memo 1
desc: TEAM UNDERCOVER, INTERNAL. Phase 1: buy every guesthouse bed in Anjuna. Phase 2: charge for sleep. Phase 3: charge for dreams.

name: Undercover Memo 2
desc: Phase 2 update: influencers have fenced off the sunset. Looking west now costs Rs 2000. Dopamine bottling Backstage is on schedule.

name: Undercover Memo 3
desc: Phase 3: when the bottles are full, the Promoter cuts the power to every free party in Goa. Only the Mainstage stays loud. Shred after reading.

name: Lost Sandals
desc: Leather sandals, one strap held on with a hair tie. Somebody at the Sunrise Guesthouse misses these.

name: Friendship Band
desc: To hold. Heals a sixteenth of its Serotonin at the end of every turn.

name: Neon Glowstick
desc: To hold. Its moves hit 10% harder.

name: Lucky Rupee
desc: To hold. A coin with a hole in it. More critical hits.

name: Steel Flask
desc: To hold. Its moves cost one less Hydration.

name: Tie-Dye Shirt
desc: Cosmetic. Pink, swirly, faintly damp. Wear it from the Stash Tin.

name: Cotton Kurta
desc: Cosmetic. Long, white and breezy. Wear it from the Stash Tin.

name: Sequin Vest
desc: Cosmetic. Catches every laser in the valley. Wear it from the Stash Tin.

name: Glow Jacket
desc: Cosmetic. Black with neon green trim. Wear it from the Stash Tin.

name: Festival Poncho
desc: Cosmetic. A poncho and a straw hat, a thank-you from the guesthouse. Wear it from the Stash Tin.

name: Crab Suit
desc: Cosmetic. A lilo and two oven gloves, from the Crab Raver. Wear it from the Stash Tin.

name: Record Crate
desc: A crate of vinyl with a sticker: PROPERTY OF THE BOOTH. The roadie in the DJ Booth is looking for these.

name: Vicchio Antenna
desc: Mantequilla's nonno's antenna, bent into the shape of Tuscany. It crackles near Glowing Caps, and sometimes it talks.

name: Glowing Cap
desc: A mushroom that glows softly green, but only for people on the right frequency. Mantequilla needs three.

name: Sombrero
desc: Cosmetic. Mantequilla's sombrero. If anyone asks, you are from Vicchio. Wear it from the Stash Tin.

name: Green Coconut
desc: A green coconut from the palms on the Jungle Shortcut, heavy and sloshing. Somebody at a shrine would know what it is for.

name: Festival Timetable
desc: Banyan's photocopy of the festival timetable, folded into eighths. See the Sets page in your Fanny Pack.
